TOOLING BURST FL-6d — £0 ALIGNMENT after FL-5/FL-5c/FL-6/FL-6c (Run C-5; conductor R-C5-139). task_id "FL-6d". No runtime, spec or kit change expected; report any genuine regression and fix the runtime only then.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows FL-4d (the previous alignment's rules), FL-5, FL-5c, FL-6, FL-6c and the new row "FL-6d — alignment after FL-5/FL-6; tests read artifacts, never staged copies" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. The current specs/kits as LAW: runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, runs/C-5/specs/blackwater_cocktail.json, the kits fire_bolt_e1_A/B, fire_burst_e0p_v3, blackwater_cocktail_e3 (kit.json), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json (18); export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (read for what the runtime NOW does); the three test files; fixtures/fl1b/ (byte locks: re-baseline only with the FL-1b diff rule); runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-parallax-in-v10/walkable.json and runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-props-v25/ (the artifacts of record for scene inputs).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

THE REDS (conductor, outside suite after FL-6c; the five standing oracle reds and the E3-r1 catalogue lock are NOT yours): tests/test_effect_kit.py: ProjectileArmValidationTests.test_both_arms_preserve_spec_and_quantised_primitives; ProjectileArmValidationTests.test_empty_key_arms_have_identical_kit_files_except_name; FL2FieldValidationTests.test_all_new_fields_validate_in_actual_catalogue; AntiDecalValidationTests.test_defaults_absent_and_real_fire_fields_load. tests/test_godot_import.py: IceTreatmentImportTests.test_ten_existing_export_bytes_unchanged; BlackwaterLandingRuntimeTests (3 ERRORS: FileNotFoundError runs/C-5/cliffside_v38/parallax/walkable.json). tests/test_vfx_picker.py: ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_empty_key_exports_byte_identically_except_kit_name; ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_headless_east_contact_range_tail_and_key_schedule; ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_original_eight_export_byte_lock; FL4CByteLockTests.test_fifteen_kits_and_all_fire_art_match_pre_fl5_bytes.
What changed that these tests still encode: FL-5 (eruption ramp, range burst, head 1.0 / sheet 1.9, ember_ending re-tuned, core_residue, smoke, interleave 5-7 at 1.2-1.6), FL-5c (z-order for +y casts; tip sockets S/SW/W), FL-6 (flame_dance on fire_bolt_e1_B only — so ARMS A AND B NOW DIFFER by design: impact_binding (_v2 vs _v3) AND travel.flame_dance; re-encode "identical except name" as "identical except name, impact_binding and flame_dance" and list the fields), FL-6c (padded dance layers, tongue 1.1-1.4 at root 1.15). Byte locks: re-baseline with per-lock diff summaries attributing every entry to those bursts (the FL-1b rule); FL4CByteLockTests "pre-FL5 bytes" is by construction stale — re-encode as "the 15 non-fire kits match" + the fire kits' CURRENT hashes with the FL-5/6 attribution.
STAGED COPIES ARE NOT FIXTURES (conductor rule, N-C5-STAGED-FIXTURES): the three BlackwaterLandingRuntimeTests error on runs/C-5/cliffside_v38/parallax/walkable.json — that staged copy was pruned (staged copies are regenerable). Re-point them to the artifacts of record (runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-parallax-in-v10/walkable.json + CS-props-v25) or to a fresh export into the test's temp dir; grep all three test files for `cliffside_v` and re-point every such reference the same way.
RULE: re-encode from the current fields (never a literal); never weaken an intent; a genuine regression → fix the runtime and report it.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-6d/acceptance.json): per test old → new → why; no `cliffside_v` reference left in tests/; the named tests green in the sandbox; 18 kits byte-identical; catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; remaining reds NAMED (expected: five standing + E3-r1).
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit, any spec, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-6d/; export/ only for a named regression; fixtures/ only for byte-lock re-baselines with diffs. No Godot GUI. No deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-6d/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-6d"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
